steps.name: Iris' Anxiety (1)
steps.objective: Talk to Minuet in "Adrica", then find [Iris] in the "Frozen World".

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Hello, %s... I thought we wouldn't meet for a while, but you're back already. Nothing's wrong, is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing in particular... I just felt I should come back.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: As it happens, I had something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Visit the other part of Iris's heart, the one fighting malice within her mind.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: ...I think that part of her has something to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wouldn't it be better to ask Iris directly? I'll call her. We're connected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, Iris. If you can hear me, could you come out and talk for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No matter how long you wait, there is no response.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We can't talk whenever we want... Do you know anything, Minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I don't know anything!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Really. I truly don't know anything else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Thank you for telling me. I'll find out myself.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'll always tell you what I know. Whenever there's something new. Oh, and...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I've forgotten!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, are you pretending not to remember?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: No, I really forgot! I can't remember.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'm not what's important now. Go find the heart fighting so hard within Iris's inner world!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Welcome, %s... I've been waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it all right for me to stay a while now?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes. We can talk briefly.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: My true self is training hard, and with your help, the malice within is gradually weakening.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Though I can't let my guard down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard you had something to say.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Goddess Gaia sent you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her incarnation Minuet, to be precise...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: She must have been worried about me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me anything you want. I'll listen.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll wait. Take your time.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No, there's no time. If I don't hurry, the malice I barely subdued might wake again.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: ...Do you remember the friends who traveled with me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. All of them.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. Could you meet them, if possible?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just meet them?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes. Tell them Iris is well.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And that I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your friends are my friends, too. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But I don't think I can meet everyone. I don't know where some of them are...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's all right. Just visit those in Jiendia you can find.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Levi... Usually at Elias Palace, if nothing's happened. Should I go there?)

steps.name: Iris' Anxiety (3)
steps.objective: Find the [Dark Moon Princess] in "Dark Moon Castle".

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It's been a while, %s.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain what has happened to Iris.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I'm visiting her old companions on her behalf.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm glad Zoe and Muwen are with her. Thank you for bringing the news.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: So much has happened to Lady Iris. And she still faces a harsh fate.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I want to help, too, but I fear there's nothing I can do. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: (Levi seems lost in thought for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm sorry I have nothing more to offer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Iris and I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you heard anything of the others?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm sorry. I asked around before, but I don't know where they are. I'll tell you as soon as I find them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Until next time, Levi.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Have you heard anything about her?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her...? Oh, Pandora.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Yes... Do you know anything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. Nothing at the moment.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I understand. May I ask one last question?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Whom will you visit next?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris asked me to meet those in Jiendia... Someone who comes to mind...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The Dark Moon Princess is well. I saw her recently, and her health has improved considerably.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'd like to see her. It's been a while. I'll go to Dark Moon Castle...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Travel safely. And give Lady Iris my regards.

steps.name: Iris' Anxiety (4)
steps.objective: Obtain <Fragments of Memory> in the "Dragon Valley". Then report to the [Dark Moon Princess] in "Dark Moon Castle".

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: How dare you enter this place?!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (The princess aims her bow at %s, looking even more threatening than on your previous visit.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad, Princess. You look much healthier...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What are you talking about? I've always been healthy. Who are you, anyway? Do you know me?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Anyone from Aoich would know me... But who are you?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Oh! I wondered what the commotion was. It's you. It's been a while. Have you been well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, my lord.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Very well, thanks to you. And thank you for helping my daughter... I've heard of your exploits, even from afar.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father, do you know this person? They entered without permission. Though an ordinary person wouldn't even consider coming here.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: My daughter, this is the one who helped you. In Midgard...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Oh! I'm sorry I didn't recognize you. How can I thank you?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I was so overwhelmed then that I didn't know who saved me. Tell me where you're staying, and I'll send a reward.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Daughter, may we have a moment alone? There's something I need to discuss.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you want to say, my lord?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Isn't it obvious? My daughter's memories.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: While I was searching for her after she vanished, Shino, who runs a tavern in Midgard, brought her back.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: As the emptiness in her eyes showed, she remembered only her family and matters concerning Dark Moon Castle.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: She couldn't remember Choen at all, despite their long time together.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: The very expression of someone who had lost memories. Your discomfort told me you knew about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An expression of lost memories...?)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Before she left Aoich, a resident told me you seemed to have met her.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: No need to explain at length. It was the result of her choice. My daughter always chooses rightly. She must have then, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My lord! Forgive the interruption. I've thought of something. I'll go take care of it and return quickly.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Hehe. That expression suggests you've found a good approach.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It won't be perfect, but it may help a little.

steps.name: Iris' Anxiety (5)
steps.objective: Talk to the [Dark Moon Princess] in "Dark Moon Castle", then find [Iris] in the "Frozen World".

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: How dare you enter... Oh? It's you from before. Is something happening at Dark Moon Castle again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: My beloved daughter, I asked this person to come.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father, I love you too, but appearing suddenly and trying to hug me so fiercely...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (The princess aims her bow at her father. The practiced movement suggests this has happened many times.)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Sniff... My daughter... My daughter...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I won't fall for it again! I already have your eye drops!

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Tsk... No helping it. My beloved daughter, stay and hear what %s has to say.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Something interesting for me to hear?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I brought something that may help. You only need to keep it with you, Princess.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: What's it called? It feels full of primal power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A Memory Fragment. Just keep it with you.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Simply keeping it is enough...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It should react only to someone who has lost memories. Probably...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: So you're not quite certain, either.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (The princess regards the Memory Fragment suspiciously. At her father's nod, she takes it in hand.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (The fragment dissolves in her hand. Sensing something, the princess slowly grows pale.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I feel like I've been forgetting something all this time... But I don't know what...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (Her expression returns to normal. She seems somewhat steadier.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yes. That's right. You were traveling to find Iris. Did you find her?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Where is she?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain what has happened to Iris.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I see. Even so, I'll never understand Iris. I don't want to. And...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Princess, do you remember a little now?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yes, Father. Not everything... But I feel like there's someone I've forgotten.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (The princess falls silent, and tears begin to gather in her eyes.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: %s... Why did you bring me this? Why am I suddenly feeling this way?!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father, Father... Do you know whom I've forgotten? I feel like I know, but the name... I can't say the name...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Daughter, you should rest today. Go inside.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: (Once she leaves, loneliness enters her father's gaze.)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Now I understand why she can't remember that child... I don't know what contract was made, but the price was my daughter's memories...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: How cruel. How did it come to this...?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Thank you, anyway. You helped recover at least part of her memories... When you return, give my regards to Iris... To Goddess Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You're back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I visited Elias Palace and Dark Moon Castle. Everyone is well and sends their regards.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I also brought the princess a Memory Fragment from Dragon Valley...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If I'd done better, perhaps the Dark Moon Princess wouldn't have suffered like that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That wasn't your fault, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I feel as though the cruel fate laid upon this world has done this to everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fate...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something bad happened. The kind of bad thing that could happen to anyone...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't give in to despair. Is helping you my fate? Is forgetting fragments of my memories fate, too? It isn't.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Your memories, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... I know there are things you can't help, that your true self is trying, and that the one speaking to me is the vulnerable part of your heart.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But hearing only despair wears me down, too. Don't worry about it too much.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't properly met your true self yet, but I'll come soon. I'd like us to meet properly then.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's something I couldn't tell you earlier... I don't think you can meet my true self until my power is complete.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: We're mentally connected. In this unstable state, being too close could disrupt that connection.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then it can't be helped...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'll come again later. I'll work hard until I can meet your true self, not only your heart.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes. I'll do my best, too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: (The heart of Iris watches %s leave.)

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: What a ridiculous heart you are. Hiding that from a human who sacrificed so much time to meet you? Shall I go tell them?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's something they mustn't know. For their own sake.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Isn't that for the human to decide?

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: No answer? Your conscience must be pricking you. Then it's my turn to rise again!

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Let's see who wins within the heart of the god called Iris!
